newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Don Pedro says mills record sugar in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Don Pedro says mills record sugar in 96/97.

text.p: Sugar miller Central Azucarera Don Pedro (CADP) said on Monday it milled a record 1.5 million tonnes of sugar cane during the crop year 1996-1997 ended May.

"CADP milled a record of 1.5 million tonnes of cane and produced 2.9 million 50-kg bags equivalent to 147,000 tonnes of raw sugar. This production is 17 percent and 25 percent higher than last year's performance," the company said in a statement.
The company said the high recovery rate of 2.02 bags per tonne cane was due to its better cane selection and decreasing delays from cane harvesting to grinding.
"We have been able to achieve higher operating efficiencies due to our perseverance to constantly improve our operational systems and capabilities," CADP chairman Pedro Roxas said.
A recent expansion programme increased its production capacity to 18,000 bags per day from 14,000 bags. It also implemented measures to speed up the hauling of cane from the planters.
